### [`symbol_table_leftover`](../../../../src/dev/symbol_table.asm#L6) `$8F3D-$8FFF`

*data*

Part of the developer's symbol table: 12-byte records of a 6-byte name, $a8 $00, the value and two bytes. A colon marks a local name.
Tail of a record with the value $8A63, irq_keys_done. $8F42: KEY1 = $8A66.
